sectorProfile.coreDebate: AI and data-center demand structural versus cyclical, and inventory

result: Revenue and EPS beat and DC rose 68%, but shares fell 2.4% on a high bar.
summary: Adjusted EPS of $2.14 beat the $2.02 Street by 5.9%.
Data Center revenue of $24.30B rose 67.6% Y/Y.
Adjusted gross margin held at 64.2%, roughly flat sequentially.
Positive: adjusted EPS of $2.14 topped the $2.02 consensus.
Negative: Data Center growth slowed to 15.2% Q/Q as the base scaled.
Net: shares fell 2.4% to $142.30 as the beat cleared a very high bar.
Whether Data Center growth sustains as quarterly revenue nears $35B.

Dollar additions stay the largest ever even as percentage growth normalizes.
Partially Supported. Revenue beat 3.8% and margin held firm.

resultsCap: Consensus is the latest pre-print InSync mean. Data Center, networking and margin have no clean quarterly consensus. Non-GAAP (ex-1x) where applicable.
takeaway: Revenue beat 3.8% and EPS 5.9% with Data Center up 68% Y/Y. Shares fell 2.4% as the print cleared a high bar.
drove: **Data Center.** Revenue reached $24.30B, up 15.2% Q/Q on AI accelerator demand.
**Networking.** Networking revenue rose 93.1% Y/Y to $5.60B as systems attach grew.
**Margin.** Adjusted EBIT margin reached 41.5%, up 6.3pp Y/Y on scale.
**Mix.** Rack-scale systems drove the sequential revenue step-up.
kpiHier: Data Center revenue of $24.30B is the core driver at three quarters of revenue.
Networking DC revenue is the fastest-growing sub-segment.
Adjusted EBIT margin of 41.5% reflects operating scale.
